title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Air Starter Heat Shield Obsolescence, Retrofit Scope
abstract: Closed pre-analysis of the heat shield obsolescence change, confirming that no retrofit was needed for the shield itself but leaving the in-service fretting finding without a disposition.

sections.objective: Establish whether the obsolescence-driven heat shield change needed a retrofit offer, and what to do about the fretting finding at the duct standoffs on aircraft that will keep the delivered shield.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and none blocking. The delivered shield remains serviceable for the life of the aircraft, so no retrofit is needed for obsolescence reasons and the production change alone answers the supply problem. The standoff move that travels with the new shield does address the fretting finding, but only on production aircraft, which leaves the whole in-service fleet recording a finding at every engine change with no action attached to it. The removal task records the fretting condition and will keep doing so. That gap was recorded and later became a separate proposal for a bracket and retention kit that could be applied to the delivered shield. The crew start procedure was checked and is unaffected.
sections.next_steps: Closed with the production change only. The in-service fretting gap was written up and raised as a separate proposal in July 2026.

similarity_seeds: a production change that leaves the in-service fleet with an unanswered finding

tasks.title: Confirm the delivered shield remains serviceable for life
Assess the in-service fretting finding disposition

expected_findings.rationale: The removal task requires the fretting condition to be recorded at every engine change, and after this change the in-service fleet has a finding with no disposition attached to it.
expected_findings.resolution: Keep the recording step and state in the task that no action is required pending a separate proposal.

expected_findings.rationale: The gap identified here became a separate proposal to apply the standoff move to the delivered shield, which overlaps this change in everything but the shield itself.
expected_findings.resolution: Keep the two aligned so that one bracket part serves both if possible.

evidence.similarity_note: The crew start procedure describes the automatic start sequence and the bleed supply in crew vocabulary and contains no reference to the shield, the standoffs or the harness.

expected_findings.rationale: The crew procedure was checked because the change touches the starter installation, and it is unaffected. Recorded so that the check is not repeated.

type_data.conclusion: Closed. Production change only; the in-service fretting gap was raised as a separate proposal.
